card.name: First digit inside multi-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A leading digit (often 1, 2 or 3) or a decimal point in the middle of a number, where more digits follow. Seen in doses, lab values, ranges and table cells.

modes.label: Leading digit
modes.description: The first digit of a two-digit number, with another digit still to come.
modes.example: FANAPT 12 mg twice daily was associated with a mean QTcF increase from baseline of about <<1>>9 msec.

modes.label: Decimal point
modes.description: The point after a leading digit, before the decimals.

card.plain: It fires at the start of a number whose remaining digits are about to follow, as in doses and lab values.
